name: bit-campus-footfall-analytics
description: BIT Campus Footfall Analytics Monorepo (React Frontend + Node.js/Python Backends)

scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently -n "FRONTEND,NODE-BACKEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm.cmd --prefix frontend run dev" "npm.cmd --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.dev:python: npx --yes concurrently -n "FRONTEND,FASTAPI" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm.cmd --prefix frontend run dev" "python backend-python/run.py"
scripts.install:all: npm.cmd --prefix frontend install && npm.cmd --prefix backend install
scripts.build: npm.cmd --prefix frontend run build && npm.cmd --prefix backend run build
